title: Kanagawa Project Configuration
description: Configuration file for Kanagawa VS Code extension project settings

importPaths.description: Additional directories to search for imported Kanagawa modules. Paths are relative to the workspace root.

stdlibPath.description: Override for the Kanagawa standard library location. Relative paths are resolved against the workspace root.

exclude.description: Glob patterns for files and folders to exclude from indexing. Patterns are matched against relative paths.
